    "df = df.sort_values(\"area\")\n",
    "bigest = df.iloc[[-3]].to_file(\"../data/parcelles/gironde/pins_2.geojson\", driver=\"GeoJSON\")"

   "source": [
    "aoi_geom, _, _ = load_aoi(GEOJSON_PATH)\n",
    "aoi_crs = manifest.get(\"aoi_crs\", \"EPSG:4326\")\n",
    "\n",
    "scene = scenes[6]\n",
    "band_name = \"B04_10m\"\n",
    "rel_path = get_band_path(scene, band_name)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Scène          :\", scene[\"id\"])\n",
    "print(\"Date           :\", scene[\"datetime\"])\n",
    "print(\"Cloud cover    :\", scene.get(\"cloud_cover\"), \"%\")\n",
    "print(\"valid_fraction :\", scene.get(\"valid_fraction\"))\n",
    "print(\"Chemin bande   :\", rel_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "band_path = zone_dir / rel_path\n",
    "assert band_path.exists(), f\"Fichier absent : {band_path}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "data, outside = load_band_with_aoi_mask(band_path, aoi_geom, aoi_crs)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Shape           :\", data.shape)\n",
    "print(\"dtype           :\", data.dtype)\n",
    "print(\"Pixels dans AOI :\", int((~outside).sum()))\n",
    "print(\"min/max (AOI)   :\", data[~outside].min(), data[~outside].max())\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Montre ndvi et ndmi \n",
    "\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "from ingest import get_band_path\n",
    "from ingest.raster import load_band_with_aoi_mask\n",
    "\n",
    "from analysis.visualize import plot_timeseries, plot_spatial_anomaly\n",
    "\n",
    "# 1. Charger les bandes\n",
    "b04, outside = load_band_with_aoi_mask(zone_dir / get_band_path(scene, \"B04_10m\"), aoi_geom, aoi_crs)\n",
    "b08, _       = load_band_with_aoi_mask(zone_dir / get_band_path(scene, \"B08_10m\"), aoi_geom, aoi_crs)\n",
    "b11_20m, _   = load_band_with_aoi_mask(zone_dir / get_band_path(scene, \"B11_20m\"), aoi_geom, aoi_crs)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 2. Rééchantillonnage \"brut\" (nearest neighbor) et rognage pour matcher exactement B08\n",
    "b11 = np.repeat(np.repeat(b11_20m, 2, axis=0), 2, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "# On force b11 à avoir exactement la même shape que b08\n",
    "h, w = b08.shape\n",
    "b11 = b11[:h, :w]\n",
    "outside = outside[:h, :w] # Au cas où le masque aurait aussi 1 pixel de décalage\n",
    "\n",
    "# 3. Conversion en float\n",
    "b04 = b04.astype(float)\n",
    "b08 = b08.astype(float)\n",
    "b11 = b11.astype(float)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 4. Calcul du NDVI\n",
    "ndvi = np.zeros_like(b08)\n",
    "np.divide((b08 - b04), (b08 + b04), out=ndvi, where=(b08 + b04) != 0)\n",
    "ndvi[outside] = np.nan\n",
    "\n",
    "# 5. Calcul du NDMI\n",
    "ndmi = np.zeros_like(b08)\n",
    "np.divide((b08 - b11), (b08 + b11), out=ndmi, where=(b08 + b11) != 0)\n",
    "ndmi[outside] = np.nan\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n"
   ]

   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "from pathlib import Path # Au cas où il manquerait dans ton notebook\n",
    "\n",
    "# 1. Charger l'AOI (nécessaire pour le masque hors-parcelle)\n",
    "aoi_geom, _, _ = load_aoi(GEOJSON_PATH)\n",
    "aoi_crs = \"EPSG:4326\"\n",
    "\n",
    "# 2. Préparation de la boucle\n",
    "results = []\n",
    "print(f\"Calcul des indices sur {len(scenes)} scènes exploitables...\")\n",
    "\n",
    "for i, sc in enumerate(scenes):\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        # Récupérer les chemins\n",
    "        path_b04 = get_band_path(sc, \"B04_10m\")\n",
    "        path_b08 = get_band_path(sc, \"B08_10m\")\n",
    "        path_b11 = get_band_path(sc, \"B11_20m\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        if not path_b04 or not path_b08 or not path_b11:\n",
    "            print(f\"  Skip {sc['id']} : bandes manquantes\")\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "            \n",
    "        # Charger les bandes\n",
    "        b04, outside = load_band_with_aoi_mask(zone_dir / path_b04, aoi_geom, aoi_crs)\n",
    "        b08, _       = load_band_with_aoi_mask(zone_dir / path_b08, aoi_geom, aoi_crs)\n",
    "        b11_20m, _   = load_band_with_aoi_mask(zone_dir / path_b11, aoi_geom, aoi_crs)\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Aligner B11 (20m) sur B08 (10m)\n",
    "        b11 = np.repeat(np.repeat(b11_20m, 2, axis=0), 2, axis=1)\n",
    "        h, w = b08.shape\n",
    "        b11 = b11[:h, :w]\n",
    "        outside = outside[:h, :w]\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Convertir en float\n",
    "        b04 = b04.astype(float)\n",
    "        b08 = b08.astype(float)\n",
    "        b11 = b11.astype(float)\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Calcul NDVI\n",
    "        ndvi = np.zeros_like(b08)\n",
    "        np.divide((b08 - b04), (b08 + b04), out=ndvi, where=(b08 + b04) != 0)\n",
    "        ndvi[outside] = np.nan\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Calcul NDMI\n",
    "        ndmi = np.zeros_like(b08)\n",
    "        np.divide((b08 - b11), (b08 + b11), out=ndmi, where=(b08 + b11) != 0)\n",
    "        ndmi[outside] = np.nan\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Stocker les médianes\n",
    "        date_str = sc[\"datetime\"][:10]\n",
    "        results.append({\n",
    "            \"date\": pd.to_datetime(date_str),\n",
    "            \"ndvi_median\": np.nanmedian(ndvi),\n",
    "            \"ndmi_median\": np.nanmedian(ndmi)\n",
    "        })\n",
    "        \n",
    "        if (i + 1) % 10 == 0:\n",
    "            print(f\"  [{i+1}/{len(scenes)}] traité...\")\n",
    "            \n",
    "    except Exception as e:\n",
    "        print(f\"  Erreur sur scène {sc['id']} : {e}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# 3. Création du DataFrame et lissage mensuel\n",
    "df = pd.DataFrame(results).sort_values(\"date\")\n",
    "df_time = df.set_index('date')\n",
    "df_monthly = df_time.resample('MS').median()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 4. Affichage de la courbe\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 6))\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.plot(df_monthly.index, df_monthly['ndvi_median'], 'g-o', linewidth=2, markersize=6, label='NDVI Médian (Mensuel)')\n",
    "ax.plot(df_monthly.index, df_monthly['ndmi_median'], 'b-s', linewidth=2, markersize=6, label='NDMI Médian (Mensuel)')\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.set_title(\"Évolution mensuelle médiane - NDVI vs NDMI (Zone pins_1)\", fontsize=14)\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel(\"Date\", fontsize=12)\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(\"Valeur de l'indice\", fontsize=12)\n",
    "ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)\n",
    "ax.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=11)\n",
    "ax.set_ylim(0, 0.8)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  }
 ],

   "source": [
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "from ingest import load_manifest, get_usable_scenes, get_band_path\n",
    "from ingest.raster import load_band_with_aoi_mask\n",
    "from ingest.search import load_aoi\n",
    "\n",
    "# Import de ton package de visualisation !\n",
    "from analysis import plot_timeseries, plot_spatial_anomaly\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- 1. Setup ---\n",
    "OUTPUT_DIR = Path(\"./data/ingested\")\n",
    "ZONE_NAME = \"pins_1\"\n",
    "GEOJSON_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR.parent / \"parcelles/gironde/pins_1.geojson\"\n",
    "\n",
    "zone_dir = OUTPUT_DIR / ZONE_NAME\n",
    "print(zone_dir)\n",
    "manifest = load_manifest(zone_dir)\n",
    "\n",
    "scenes = get_usable_scenes(manifest)\n",
    "aoi_geom, _, _ = load_aoi(GEOJSON_PATH)\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- 2. Série Temporelle ---\n",
    "results = []\n",
    "for sc in scenes:\n",
    "    b04, outside = load_band_with_aoi_mask(zone_dir / get_band_path(sc, \"B04_10m\"), aoi_geom, \"EPSG:4326\")\n",
    "    b08, _       = load_band_with_aoi_mask(zone_dir / get_band_path(sc, \"B08_10m\"), aoi_geom, \"EPSG:4326\")\n",
    "    b11_20m, _   = load_band_with_aoi_mask(zone_dir / get_band_path(sc, \"B11_20m\"), aoi_geom, \"EPSG:4326\")\n",
    "    \n",
    "    b11 = np.repeat(np.repeat(b11_20m, 2, axis=0), 2, axis=1)[:b08.shape[0], :b08.shape[1]]\n",
    "    outside = outside[:b08.shape[0], :b08.shape[1]]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # IL FAUT ABSOLUMENT CONVERTIR EN FLOAT ICI !\n",
    "    b04 = b04.astype(float)\n",
    "    print(type(b04))\n",
    "    b08 = b08.astype(float)\n",
    "    b11 = b11.astype(float)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    ndvi = np.divide((b08 - b04), (b08 + b04), out=np.zeros_like(b08), where=(b08 + b04) != 0)\n",
    "    print(ndvi.shape)\n",
    "    ndvi[outside] = np.nan\n",
    "    \n",
    "    ndmi = np.divide((b08 - b11), (b08 + b11), out=np.zeros_like(b08), where=(b08 + b11) != 0)\n",
    "    ndmi[outside] = np.nan\n",
    "\n",
    "    \n",
    "    results.append({\n",
    "        \"date\": pd.to_datetime(sc[\"datetime\"][:10]),\n",
    "        \"ndvi_median\": np.nanmedian(ndvi),\n",
    "        \"ndmi_median\": np.nanmedian(ndmi)\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "# result [{date, ndvi_mean, ndmi_mean}]\n",
    "df = pd.DataFrame(results).sort_values(\"date\").set_index('date')\n",
    "df_monthly = df.resample('MS').median()\n",
    "\n",
    "# >>> APPEL DE LA VISU <<<\n",
    "plot_timeseries(df_monthly)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- 3. Anomalie Spatiale ---\n",
    "date_cible = pd.to_datetime(\"2022-08-15\")\n",
    "scene_ete = min(scenes, key=lambda s: abs(pd.to_datetime(s['datetime'][:10]) - date_cible))\n",
    "\n",
    "b08, outside = load_band_with_aoi_mask(zone_dir / get_band_path(scene_ete, \"B08_10m\"), aoi_geom, \"EPSG:4326\")\n",
    "b11_20m, _   = load_band_with_aoi_mask(zone_dir / get_band_path(scene_ete, \"B11_20m\"), aoi_geom, \"EPSG:4326\")\n",
    "b11 = np.repeat(np.repeat(b11_20m, 2, axis=0), 2, axis=1)[:b08.shape[0], :b08.shape[1]]\n",
    "\n",
    "ndmi_ete = np.divide((b08 - b11), (b08 + b11), out=np.zeros_like(b08, dtype=float), where=(b08 + b11) != 0)\n",
    "ndmi_ete[outside[:b08.shape[0], :b08.shape[1]]] = np.nan\n",
    "\n",
    "# Z-Score\n",
    "mean_ndmi = np.nanmean(ndmi_ete)\n",
    "std_ndmi = np.nanstd(ndmi_ete)\n",
    "z_score = (ndmi_ete - mean_ndmi) / std_ndmi\n",
    "anomaly_mask = z_score < -1.5\n",
    "\n",
    "# >>> APPEL DE LA VISU <<<\n",
    "plot_spatial_anomaly(ndmi_ete, z_score, anomaly_mask, scene_ete['datetime'][:10])"
   ]
  }
